title: 唱给我听

lines.text: 一家山东的客户来北京签了一份大合同，晚上，周经理请客户的老板和几位同事吃饭庆祝。

lines.en: A client from Shandong comes to Beijing to sign a big contract, and in the evening Manager Zhou takes the client's boss and a few of his colleagues out to dinner to celebrate.

lines.text: 杰克听了，又高兴又哭笑不得：他苦练了三年声调，还不如一首歌好使。

lines.en: Jack is pleased, but doesn't know whether to laugh or cry: three years of hard work on his tones, and one song does better.

lines.text: 一个星期以后，那位老板打电话来问交货时间，杰克在电话里解释了半天，对方还是没听明白。

lines.en: A week later, the boss phones to ask about the delivery date. Jack explains for ages, but the man still doesn't get it.
